data.one_liner: Tree menu widget with expandable/collapsible nodes
data.what_it_does: Provides a recursive tree of menu nodes that can be expanded or collapsed. Each node can contain sub‑nodes and a custom widget is built for each node via a builder callback.
use_when: Need a highly customizable tree structure
Want to use custom widgets for each node
Require control over twisty position and colors
avoid_when: You need asynchronous loading of nodes from a network source
You need complex state management beyond simple UI interactions
strengths: Extensive customization options (colors, decorations, twisty widget)
Supports arbitrary depth via recursive TreeNode
Simple API with nodeBuilder and onSelect callbacks
weaknesses: No built‑in support for async data loading
Limited documentation on performance with large trees
No example of integration with state management libraries
data.minimal_example:
```dart
ExpandableTree(
  nodes: [
    TreeNode('Category A', subNodes: [TreeNode('Item 1'), TreeNode('Item 2')]),
    TreeNode('Category B', subNodes: [TreeNode('Item 3')]),
  ],
  nodeBuilder: (ctx, value) => Card(child: Text(value.toString())),
  onSelect: (node) => print('Selected: $node'),
)
```
